'''Gesh's Tapcafe''' was a [[tapcafe]] in [[Jedha City]] on the [[moon]] [[Jedha]]. It was owned by [[Gesh]],<ref name="Visual Guide" /> a descendant of [[Belloq]], whose name the old [[cafe]] had previously shared<ref name="Descendant">{{Twitter|pabl0hidalgo|status/1705639694305014216|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|date=2023-09-23|quote=Sort of kept part of the Geisha name by saying the cafe's proper name is Gesh's Tapcafe, an old establishment currently run by a descendent of the Belloq in the sign. Well, 'currently' at least until the moon is blasted.|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/Teew2}}</ref> when it was known as '''Bar Belloq'''<ref name="RO Teaser">{{SWYouTube|Wji-BZ0oCwg|ROGUE ONE: A STAR WARS STORY Official Teaser Trailer}}</ref> and '''Cafe Belloq''',<ref name="CafeBelloq">{{Twitter|pabl0hidalgo|status/1705637751679553788|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|date=2023-09-23|quote=Very quick shot of the Cafe Belloq that has Imperial officers wearing what we took to calling Stasi coats and a very brief glimpse of what came to be known as the Decraniated.|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/qOGz0}}</ref> with Bar Belloq still being written on the sign.<ref name="RO Teaser" /> In [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Destroyed" /> it was bombed by insurgents targeting [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] personnel, resulting in over a dozen deaths and multiple injuries.<ref name="Visual Guide" /> The establishment was then obliterated shortly after when the [[Galactic Empire]] [[Destruction of Jedha City|destroyed]] all of Jedha City with the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[superweapon]].<ref name="Rogue One">''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref>

{{Struct-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Gesh's Tapcafe was created for the film ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'',<ref name="Rogue One" /> which was released on [[December 15]], [[2016]].<ref name="RORelease">{{WebCite|url=https://www.empireonline.com/movies/rogue-one-star-wars-story/rogue-one-switches-uk-release-date-15-december|text=Rogue One switches its UK release date to 15 December|author=White, James|date=2016-10-24|work=[[Wikipedia:Empire (magazine)|Empire]]|archivedate=20190104055211}}</ref> Prior to the film's release, it was revealed in the film's teaser trailer, which was posted on [[April 7]], [[2016]]. In the trailer, a shot shows a sign naming the bar as Bar Belloq in [[aurebesh]];<ref name="RO Teaser" /> however, this shot did not make it into the final film where the establishment goes unnamed.<ref name="Rogue One" /> [[Pablo Hidalgo]] gave the tapcafe's proper name<ref name="Descendant" /> for the first time in ''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]'', a reference book released alongside the film.<ref name="Visual Guide" /> Hidalgo created the name in reference to<ref name="Descendant" /> the [[Decraniated]] that can be seen inside, who had been known as "Headless Gesihas" during production.<ref name="Geisha">{{Twitter|pabl0hidalgo|status/1705638857323208817|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|date=2023-09-23|quote=Their creepy production name was 'Headless Geishas' which wouldn't really work in-universe, so I coined Decraniated to describe them and folded them into the Evazan story thread lurking in the text of the Guide.|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/lLLLy}}</ref> Hidalgo later clarified that Gesh's Tapcafe was the establishment seen in the film and provided explanation for the alternate names,<ref name="Descendant" /> also calling the building Cafe Belloq, on [[Wikipedia:Twitter|Twitter]] on [[September 23]], [[2023]].<ref name="CafeBelloq" />
